obv.translation: abbr. obvious 明显的; obverse （铸币、奖章等的）正面; on-balance volume 平衡交易量; octane blending value 辛烷混合值

obverse.definition:
n. the more conspicuous of two alternatives or cases or sides
n. the side of a coin or medal bearing the principal stamp or design
obverse.translation:
n. (钱币、奖章等)正面, 主要的一面, 对立面
a. 正面的, 对应面的, 倒转的

obversion.definition:
n. The act of turning toward or downward.
n. The act of immediate inference, by which we deny the
   opposite of anything which has been affirmed; as, all men are mortal;
   then, by obversion, no men are immortal. This is also described as
   "immediate inference by privative conception."
obversion.translation: n. 转向, 形成对立

obverted.translation: v. 将…的正面转向, 将…换置( obvert的过去式和过去分词 )

obverting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Obvert
obverting.translation: v. 将…的正面转向, 将…换置( obvert的现在分词 )

obverts.translation: 将…的正面转向, 将…换置( obvert的第三人称单数 )

obviate.translation: vt. 除去, 排除, 使成为不必要, 避免

obviated.translation: v. 避免, 消除（贫困、不方便等）( obviate的过去式和过去分词 )

obviates.definition:
v do away with
v prevent the occurrence of; prevent from happening
obviates.translation: v. 避免, 消除（贫困、不方便等）( obviate的第三人称单数 )

obviating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Obviate
obviating.translation: v. 避免, 消除（贫困、不方便等）( obviate的现在分词 )

obviation.definition: n. the act of preventing something by anticipating and disposing of it effectively

obviative.translation: 另指他, 第二个他(如：“他拿他的书”中的第二个“他”)

obviosity.translation: n. 显然的事物(如话语、推断等)

obvious.definition: a. easily perceived by the senses or grasped by the mind
obvious.translation: a. 明显的, 明白的, 显然的, 平淡无奇的

obviously.definition: r. unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')
obviously.translation: adv. 显而易见地, 明显地

obviousness.definition: n. the property of being easy to see and understand
obviousness.translation: n. 显而易见；明显；显著性

obvolute.translation: [植]跨褶的(指叶或花瓣), 卷压的, 重叠的

obvoluted.definition:
a. Overlapping; contorted; convolute; -- applied primarily,
   in botany, to two opposite leaves, each of which has one edge
   overlapping the nearest edge of the other, and secondarily to a circle
   of several leaves or petals which thus overlap.
obvoluted.translation: a. 交搭的；【植物学】(叶、瓣)跨褶的[亦作 obvoluted]
